rollout-raci.title: Rollout RACI matrix
rollout-raci.description: A hypothetical matrix assigns responsible, accountable, consulted and informed roles for six rollout decisions, with one accountable owner per row.

ai-manager-delegation.title: Delegating AI administration
ai-manager-delegation.description: Create a custom role, create an enterprise team and assign the role to the team, with optional ruleset bypass and the settings that stay outside the role.

pilot-group-selection.title: Selecting the pilot population
pilot-group-selection.description: Use an existing organization if one fits or create a dedicated one, then confirm each participant is licensed through the pilot organization.

pilot-cost-ceiling.title: Pilot cost ceiling trace
pilot-cost-ceiling.description: Twenty Business users at 3,000 credits each exceed a 38,000-credit pool by 22,000 credits, about $220, so a hypothetical $250 ceiling stops usage at the limit.

pre-enable-baseline.title: Pre-enable baseline
pre-enable-baseline.description: Confirm the license source, set policies, enable one organization and cap spend, on a baseline that keeps defaults on and restricts only what must be restricted.

exception-handling.title: Exception lifecycle
exception-handling.description: An exception moves from request to assessment to a scoped grant and an expiry review, which either renews after reassessment or reverts and confirms in the audit log.

enablement-timeline.title: Enablement timeline and support path
enablement-timeline.description: Preparation 45 days out, announcement at 14 days, workshop at 7 days, launch-day support and ongoing training, with a support path from developer to GitHub Support.

license-request-flow.title: Two license request flows
license-request-flow.description: In the built-in flow a member asks and an owner reviews requests; in the API flow an internal request passes optional checks before a seat is assigned automatically.

go-no-go-decision.title: Go/no-go decision
go-no-go-decision.description: Without enough evidence, extend the pilot; with evidence, criteria met leads to staged expansion, partly met to a hold and fix, and not met to rollback.

stage-gates.title: Expansion stage gates
stage-gates.description: Access widens from the pilot organization to more organizations and then the enterprise, with the same gate checklist before each stage.

outcome-reporting.title: Outcome reporting pipeline
outcome-reporting.description: A report moves from decision to comparison, evidence, separated observations and conclusions, and a narrative, with each evidence type limited to what it can show.

steady-state-review.title: Steady-state review cadence
steady-state-review.description: Changelog, audit log, usage metrics and spend feed weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews that end in a leadership report.
